opening.argument: The presentation walks sellers through a help-and-contact process for listing-related questions. It identifies seller customer care as its subject, shows viewers how to select the Selling help topic, and directs them to Contact Us when the available answer does not resolve their issue. The visible support flow offers call and email options and a form for an item number and a question or concern. In that instructional context, the phone number, one-time passcode, email form, and addresses are presented as contact procedures; the video demonstrates no financial solicitation or deceptive outcome. The support identity and destinations may still warrant external verification, but the evidence presented is ordinary seller-support instruction.
